residual_risks: Freeze-time vs cmd-start comparison must remain a strict instant comparison; an implementer truncating the sub-second freeze timestamp to whole seconds would admit a freeze up to ~1s after producer start, weakening the freeze-before-execution invariant — cross-review should pin the comparison direction.

redaction.py imports psycopg2.extensions at module scope (packages/common/redaction.py:9); if the new CLI imports it at module scope, even --help fails on a driver-less host. The fixture's static-first design makes the import unlikely, but if used, cross-review should require the function-local-import convention or explicit node27-venv-only execution.

The concrete finite timeout/output ceiling for the bounded binder invocation remains implementer freedom; cross-review should reject user-supplied executable/runner/timeout options and confirm the ceiling covers Node startup plus a 256 KiB receipt read on a loaded node-27.

The acceptance record is terminal private evidence with no downstream consumer in this slice; final production handoff remains R5 and this slice's merge must not be read as deployment completion — the R5 audit remains the enforcement point.
